d: Bihar ke mokama ke charchit aur bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ka andaj hamesha se hi surkhiyon men rahta hai… lekin is bar anant sinh apne bhari bharkam gariyon ke kaphile ke sath uttar pradesh ke daure ko lekar charcha men hain.. vo apne purane mitr pappu salman ke ghar shadi men shamil hone prayagraj ja rahe the…isi dauran anant sinh jab 400 gariyon ke kaphile ke sath jab varansi pahunche.. to harkanp mach gaya…khabar hai ki dhanteras aur divali ki bhir ka havala dekar varansi pulis ne unke is lanbe kaphile ko bich shahar men ghusne se rok diya…
